save_bones: create a 3D mesh of bone ellipsoids from pose parameters and export to OBJ file path
draw_lines: draw colored lines between pairs of 2D point coordinates on a PyTorch tensor image
save_vid: save a list of numpy frame arrays as a GIF or video file with configurable FPS
draw_cams: create a trimesh visualization of a list of 4x4 camera poses with colored axes
get_vertex_colors: query a NeRF model to get RGB vertex colors for a 3D mesh at a given frame
